chronology_requirements.timestamp_rule: prior OOM receipt timestamp must precede every preserved-family completion and the preserved-run receipt timestamp

failure_behavior.absent: family may execute in frozen order
failure_behavior.invalid-conflicting: do not delete, overwrite, repair, or start Person D
failure_behavior.reusable: family may be skipped only after every runtime check passes

per_family_required_evidence: run_state output manifest with completed status and exact target inventory
exact admitted identities under the applicability contract
no missing admitted identity, unauthorized extra identity, or duplicate identity
finite predictions and exact fit lineage
exact target, fold, frame, source-context, configuration, and seed lineage
runner receipt with exact producing commit, branch, clean worktree, and completion timestamp
authorization receipt with exact predecessor authority and authorization-record hash
environment receipt meeting both 20.0 GiB thresholds
